question.:question/worked-solution:
The numerator and denominator are $u(x)=-2$ and $v(x)=4 x - 9,$ respectively. Their derivatives are given by

$$
\begin{aligned}u^{\prime}(x)&=0,\\v^{\prime}(x)&=4.\end{aligned}
$$

Applying the quotient rule, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}f^{\prime}(x)&=\frac{u^{\prime}(x)\cdot v(x)-u(x)\cdot v^{\prime}(x)}{[v(x)]^2}\\ &=\frac{(0)\cdot (4 x - 9)-(-2)\cdot (4)}{(4 x - 9)^2}\\ &=\frac{8}{\left(4 x - 9\right)^{2}}.\end{aligned}
$$
